title: 实现预占释放承诺实际转换
permissions_impact: No new roles, shares or standard DocType permissions. Private release preview/post require existing managers, a web session, current root/ledger scope+field rights and native source access. New flag is strictly boolean true and defaults off. No public API or UI in this slice.
migration_impact: No new fields/tables/indexes. Depends on the prior27-field release evidence schema and reviewed InnoDB/unique/scope indexes. New controller code permits only the exact private context; no server migration, schema backfill or upstream edits.
rollback_plan: Disable release flag and stop all cooperating writers/workers before reverting. Preserve every root, event, confirmation, decision and encrypted receipt; retain ADR0037-compatible full-history readers and release/initial receipt verification after valid releases. Never delete financial facts or roll back to readers that assume one event.
security_impact: Default-disabled private release preview/post use full native purchase/budget inspection before evidence locks, re-read original/renewal/release history and authenticate the frozen root. Preview independently persists actor/session-bound proof hash for an exact tail, source snapshot, scope, currency/precision, balance, amount and reason. Explicit acknowledgement plus the live proof is required for a Decision+Event append in one outer-owned transaction. Standard controllers permit only exact values in a non-nested transaction-local context, enforce evidence-before-event order, recheck current source/role/scope/session/proof at each stage and refuse updates/deletes. Context exit replays all independent physical history; failures poison the guard and require full rollback. No domain commits, upstream modifications, root mutation, public API, UI, grants or automatic financial jobs. Audited idempotency encrypts proof-bearing preview receipts; completed posting receipts revalidate historical proof and full current history even after later releases. Current tests use native synthetic sources/budgets and private financial copies, synthetic sessions/clocks and an injected access denial. Actual human workflow, committed release contention, all writer coordination, period policies and hospital acceptance remain required.
test_plan: Run617 pure tests and all11 quality steps; four new release request cases cover canonical exact amount, strict fields, explicit acknowledgement and private proof representation.
